summary: dellemc.openmanage 13.0.0 known issues including pending 2.19 qualification for ome_smart_fabric_info, SNMP community type, SOCKS proxy and NFS export limits in idrac_license/diagnostics, iDRAC10 PatrolReadRatePercent, SCP revert, empty video list, and read-only volume properties.
questions: Can idrac_license export to an NFS share?
Why does idrac_system_info show an empty video list?
Why are encryption type and block_io_size ignored by redfish_storage_volume?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (13.0.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ome_smart_fabric_info`: ansible-core 2.19 qualification pending.
- `idrac_attributes`: `SNMP.1.AgentCommunity` accepts string or int on iDRAC10.
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no SOCKS proxy export.
- `idrac_license`: proxy ignored on import; **export to NFS fails**; error messages differ iDRAC9 vs 10.
- `idrac_os_deployment`: succeeds even with outdated Expose duration.
- `idrac_redfish_storage_controller`: `PatrolReadRatePercent` unsettable on iDRAC10.
- `idrac_server_config_profile`: revert doesn't remove users added after export.
- `idrac_system_info`: empty video list despite embedded video controller.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: same-name uplink modifies the existing one.
- `redfish_storage_volume`: encryption type and block_io_size bytes are read-only and ignored.
